purpose: Provide one append-only, evidence-family-aware income history for Reporting without collapsing reference productivity, accrued entitlement, realised cash flow, embedded income or market performance into one misleading number.

rewardLifecycle.claim: settlement of prior entitlement unless mechanism-specific evidence proves a distinct new income event
rewardLifecycle.afterClaim: remove settled amount from current claimable state after canonical refresh while retaining immutable earned-income and settlement evidence
rewardLifecycle.receivedOrWalletBalance: separate state/evidence family; never a replacement for earned-income history
rewardLifecycle.compounded: embedded-income family when independently proven; not current claimable
rewardLifecycle.scope: system-wide across all companies, protocols and reward tokens

historicalValuation.economicBoundary: value factual income at the evidence-aligned earning/closing boundary used by the admitted accounting event
preferredEvidence: exact canonical historical onchain price proof at or before the economic boundary
canonical Market Data history at or before the economic boundary
canonical historical Rewards price observation at or before the economic boundary
forbidden: price observed after the economic boundary
today/current spot price used to backfill a prior closed event
sale proceeds or later swap price treated as the original earned-income price without explicit mechanism-specific accounting proof
reference APR/APY used as factual reward valuation
historicalValuation.fallback: UNKNOWN, never zero and never invented
